derivations.method: No derivation of report time was needed anywhere on this roster — Report is printed in its own column for every duty. The only values worked out rather than read are calendar dates for times carrying a '+1' marker: the printed clock time is kept and the row's date advanced by one day (e.g. 2026-09-01 off duty 05:40Z+1 = 2026-09-02T05:40Z). No timezone arithmetic was involved because the header declares all times UTC.
